title: Lovely Crumbly Norwegian Pistachio Crumble
description: A delicious paleo-friendly dessert featuring ground pistachios and a floral twist, perfect for a date night, with a crumbly texture and sweet flavors, made with natural ingredients and no refined sugars.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, mix together the ground pistachios, almond flour, and coconut sugar.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Stir in the dried rose petals.
Transfer the mixture to a 6-inch baking dish and top with fresh raspberries.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Deglaze the dish with a little water to loosen the crumble from the sides.
